final: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS mean_avg FROM rating_averages) SELECT r.rating, r.avg_rate_per_day, r.avg_rate_per_day - o.mean_avg AS above_overall_mean FROM rating_averages r CROSS JOIN overall_mean o WHERE r.avg_rate_per_day > o.mean_avg ORDER BY r.rating
